entry.title: New: dsh-depguard
entry.summary: Dependency-topology guard: pre-install conflict prediction and post-install detection of duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-* copies, version drift, and vendored core services that cause Symbol-key crashes like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')". Exact install spec: github:delightor/dsh-depguard. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
